description: Permissions, sessions, authentication and interaction quality

rows.feature: Table hidden from a user (DenyBehavior.HIDDEN): absent from navigation, direct link loads nothing, backend refuses
scenarios: noPets sees Person but no Pet / Pet Note in navigation
person record neither shows nor requests the hidden pet association
negative: direct link /app/pet shows unknown resource with no data request
API query/get of pet returns 403, table metadata 404

rows.feature: Table disabled for a user (DenyBehavior.DISABLED): listed, but list/record/create/edit links explain the denial without loading data
rows.fixture: tests/acceptance/fixture/SecurityFixtures.java via SecurityAcceptanceServer (security variant) (securityLedger, base name pet, noPets)
scenarios: admin lists the ledger rows
noPets sees the Security Ledger link
negative: noPets list, record, create and edit links show the permission message and request no records
API query/get/insert/update return 403 and rows are unchanged

rows.feature: Insert permission denied: create not offered, create link refused, backend writes nothing
scenarios: viewer list has no Create button and the dashboard has no Create quick action
negative: /app/person/create shows the permission message with no form
POST /data/person returns 403 and the person count is unchanged

rows.feature: Edit permission denied: edit not offered, edit link refused, backend changes nothing
scenarios: viewer record view has no Edit action
negative: /app/person/1/edit shows the permission message without loading the record
PUT /data/person/1 returns 403 and the name is unchanged

rows.feature: Delete permission denied: delete not offered on record or bulk bar, bulk delete refused, backend deletes nothing
scenarios: record view and bulk action bar have no Delete
negative: /app/person.bulkDelete is unknown to the viewer
DELETE /data/person/1 and bulkDelete init return 403; the row remains

rows.feature: Copy requires insert permission: copy not offered and copy link refused
scenarios: viewer record view has no Copy action
negative: /app/person/1/copy shows the permission message; nothing is inserted

rows.feature: Process permission denied (hidden): processes not offered in navigation or launcher, links do not start them, backend refuses
scenarios: viewer/noProcesses have no process launcher and no process links
noProcesses keeps table rights (Create offered)
negative: /app/clonePeople and /app/greetInteractive are unknown and make no process request
legacy and v1 process init return 403; no person is cloned

rows.feature: Process disabled for a user (DenyBehavior.DISABLED): shown disabled, link explains the denial, backend refuses with no side effect
scenarios: admin runs Security Audit and one audit row is written
viewer sees the audit tile disabled and no dashboard quick action for it
negative: viewer direct link shows the permission message and never calls init
process init returns 403 and the audit log stays empty

rows.feature: Widget restrictions: hidden widgets absent, disabled widgets show a permission state without loading data, backend refuses
scenarios: admin sees both pet widgets with their content
noPets sees the open bulletin widget
negative: noPets: hidden widget absent, disabled widget shows "You do not have permission to view this data." and no /widget request
GET /widget/<denied> returns 403

rows.feature: App restrictions: hidden apps absent from navigation and unknown by link; disabled apps keep their children gated
rows.fixture: tests/acceptance/fixture/SecurityFixtures.java via SecurityAcceptanceServer (security variant) (securityPetApp hidden, securityPetDisabledApp disabled)
scenarios: admin sees both pet apps
negative: noPets: Pet Vault App absent and /app/securityPetApp unknown; Pet Disabled App children stay permission-gated

rows.feature: Record-level security (sharing demo): users see only their own or shared saved views/reports; direct links and writes to others are refused
scenarios: alice lists and opens her own saved view
negative: bob's list omits alice's view; bob's direct link shows not found
bob's GET/PUT/DELETE of alice's view are refused and the row is unchanged

rows.feature: Record security lock on a data table: list filtered to the key, other users' records unreachable, forged owner refused
rows.fixture: tests/acceptance/fixture/SecurityFixtures.java via SecurityAcceptanceServer (security variant) (securityNote locked by sample user)
scenarios: alice sees and edits only her notes (persisted)
negative: bob's direct link to alice's note shows not found
bob's update/delete of alice's note and insert with alice as owner are refused; SQL unchanged

rows.feature: Field protection: hidden fields never shown or returned, password fields masked and never overwritten by the mask, heavy fields not loaded in lists
source: qqq-backend-core actions/tables/QueryAction.java (omit hidden, mask PASSWORD, REVEAL)
scenarios: REVEAL password can be revealed on request
editing another field keeps the stored password
negative: hidden value absent from list, record, edit form and API responses
masked password shows only the mask; the list query does not carry the heavy BLOB

rows.feature: Capability restrictions: tables without insert/update/delete capabilities offer none of them and refuse direct links
scenarios: admin can list and view the archive
negative: no Create/Edit/Delete offered; create and edit links explain the table cannot be changed
backend insert/update/delete are refused; SQL unchanged

rows.feature: Permission revoked mid-session: stale UI actions are refused by the backend with a clear message, nothing is written, reload reflects the new rights
scenarios: after reload the viewer rights are shown
negative: saving an open edit form after revocation shows a permission error and the row is unchanged

rows.feature: MOCK sign-in: a deep link establishes the session and shows the session user from manageSession values
scenarios: lands on the requested page with rows
user menu shows Alice (sample) / sample:alice

rows.feature: Logout: POST /qqq/v1/logout ends the session, protected pages stay on login, Sign in returns to the page, per-user client data is cleared
scenarios: Sign in returns to the original page
negative: after logout a protected page (full load) stays on login and reads no data
a different user signing in on the same browser never sees the previous user's cached pages or recent records

rows.feature: Session expiry: 401 redirects to login with returnTo and re-authenticates back to the page (initial load and mid-use)
scenarios: expired on first load returns to the page
expired mid-use returns to the clicked record
negative: no hang on "Setting up anonymous session"

rows.feature: Denied sign-in: a 401 from manageSession keeps the user out with an explanation (no silent anonymous fallback)
negative: login shows "Sign-in was denied", no navigation or data is rendered

rows.feature: Post-login returnTo is limited to in-app paths (open-redirect guard)
scenarios: in-app returnTo with query string is honoured
negative: absolute, protocol-relative, backslash and javascript: targets land on /app

rows.feature: OAUTH2 authorization code + PKCE sign-in with an owned OIDC provider (discovery, authorize, callback, backend token exchange, session, reload resume)
scenarios: authorize request carries S256 challenge, state, client id, scopes and /token redirect
backend exchanges code + verifier with client secret; user_session row stored
provider identity is displayed; reload resumes without the provider

rows.feature: OAUTH2 sign-in failures: provider denial, tampered state and failed code exchange are reported and create no session
negative: access_denied shows the provider denial
a state mismatch is rejected before any token exchange
a rejected code exchange shows the failure; no user_session row

rows.feature: OAUTH2 logout: backend session deleted, provider end-session called, next visit requires provider sign-in
scenarios: user_session row deleted and provider session ended
negative: protected page after logout returns to the provider login

rows.feature: OAUTH2 session revoked server-side mid-use: 401 sends the user through the provider and back to the page
scenarios: returns to the same page after provider sign-in
negative: revoked session gets 401, not stale data

rows.feature: AUTH_0 authorization code + PKCE with an owned Auth0-compatible provider (browser token exchange, backend JWT validation via JWKS)
scenarios: sign-in and data access through the Auth0 module
logout returns through the provider
negative: provider denial is reported

rows.feature: AUTH_0 against a real Auth0 tenant
rows.fixture: Requires an Auth0 tenant QRun does not own in CI
scenarios: real tenant sign-in/logout
rows.approval: PENDING James: needs a real Auth0 tenant and credentials; the owned Auth0-compatible provider covers the flow in SEC-029

rows.feature: FULLY_ANONYMOUS authentication: session without an identity provider, anonymous identity, logout and sign-in again
scenarios: deep link loads data as Anonymous
negative: after logout the page stays signed out until Sign in

rows.feature: Unsupported authentication type (TABLE_BASED, also unsupported by Material) is reported, never silently treated as another type
negative: login shows "Unsupported authentication type: TABLE_BASED" and no data is requested

rows.feature: Server-side logout invalidation: v1 logout expires every session cookie it issued and an ended Auth0 session cannot be replayed
scenarios: logout response expires sessionUUID and sessionId
negative: a logged-out Auth0 sessionUUID replayed against the API gets 401

rows.feature: Keyboard: navigate from the sidebar to a list, open a record, edit and save without a pointer
rows.fixture: qqq-sample-project (stock sample, mock auth, sharing demo)
scenarios: edit saved by keyboard persists (SQL)

rows.feature: Keyboard: run a process through its steps without a pointer
rows.fixture: qqq-sample-project (stock sample, mock auth, sharing demo)
scenarios: greetInteractive completes and shows results

rows.feature: Dialogs trap focus, close on Escape and restore focus to the trigger; confirm by keyboard
rows.fixture: qqq-sample-project (stock sample, mock auth, sharing demo)
scenarios: keyboard delete confirmation deletes the row (SQL)
negative: Escape cancels without deleting; focus returns to Delete

rows.feature: Command menu, search and shortcut dialogs: keyboard open, focus inside, Escape restores focus
rows.fixture: qqq-sample-project (stock sample, mock auth, sharing demo)
scenarios: command menu navigates to a table
negative: Escape closes and returns focus

rows.feature: Automated accessibility scan (axe WCAG 2.1 AA) of login, dashboard, list, record, edit form and process step
rows.fixture: qqq-sample-project (stock sample, mock auth, sharing demo)
scenarios: no serious or critical violations on each page

rows.feature: Form labels and ARIA: every field has an accessible label, required fields are marked, invalid fields announce their error
rows.fixture: qqq-sample-project (stock sample, mock auth, sharing demo)
scenarios: labels match metadata labels
negative: submitting empty required fields sets aria-invalid and a described error

rows.feature: Validation and error messages: client and backend validation name the field and nothing is saved
rows.fixture: qqq-sample-project (stock sample, mock auth, sharing demo)
negative: missing required value is named and focused
backend rejection is shown verbatim; SQL unchanged

rows.feature: Responsive layout at phone width (Pixel 7): navigation drawer, list, record and form usable without horizontal scrolling
rows.fixture: qqq-sample-project (stock sample, mock auth, sharing demo)
scenarios: drawer navigation to a list, open and edit a record on a phone viewport
negative: no horizontal page overflow

rows.feature: Loading states: a delayed list or record request shows a busy state, then the real data
rows.fixture: qqq-sample-project (stock sample, mock auth, sharing demo)
scenarios: busy indicator while the real request is held, then rows

rows.feature: Failed request and recovery: a failed list request shows an error with retry; retry loads the data
rows.fixture: qqq-sample-project (stock sample, mock auth, sharing demo)
scenarios: retry succeeds
negative: the failure is explained, not a blank page

rows.feature: Delayed save: the submit control is disabled while saving and double submission creates one record
rows.fixture: qqq-sample-project (stock sample, mock auth, sharing demo)
scenarios: exactly one row inserted (SQL)
negative: second click while pending is ignored

rows.feature: Stale state: changes and deletions made elsewhere are shown after refresh/navigation, not stale cache
rows.fixture: qqq-sample-project (stock sample, mock auth, sharing demo)
scenarios: record edited through the API shows the new value on revisit
negative: record deleted through the API shows not found

rows.feature: Empty state: a query with no results explains it and offers the create action
rows.fixture: qqq-sample-project (stock sample, mock auth, sharing demo)
scenarios: no-match filter shows the empty message and Create

rows.feature: Backend unavailable at sign-in: the login page explains the failure and recovers with Try again
rows.fixture: qqq-sample-project (stock sample, mock auth, sharing demo)
scenarios: Try again after recovery signs in
negative: network failure shows "Sign-in failed"
